title: CodeCrunch: Improving Serverless Performance via Function Compression and Cost-Aware Warmup Location Optimization
problem: Serverless functions experience cold start latency when invoked. While pre-warming functions reduces this, warmed instances consume memory and incur continuous keep-alive costs, which become prohibitively expensive under bursty loads and high memory pressure.
motivation: Balancing cold start performance with memory consumption and operational cost is critical for efficient serverless computing systems.
method: CodeCrunch introduces function compression to reduce the memory footprint of warm function instances. It leverages server heterogeneity through a cost-aware warmup location optimization algorithm that intelligently selects which servers should maintain warm instances, balancing performance benefits against memory and cost constraints during periods of high pressure.
key_novelty: Combining serverless function compression with cost-aware warmup location optimization that exploits server heterogeneity to reduce cold starts while managing memory and keep-alive costs.
contributions: Function compression technique for reducing memory footprint of serverless functions
Cost-aware warmup location optimization algorithm leveraging server heterogeneity
Improved efficiency under high memory pressure and bursty workload conditions
limitations: Not discussed in abstract; evaluation scope not specified.
primary_theme: Serverless cold start mitigation through compression and heterogeneity-aware warmup placement
